title: PPL Modpack - 紫气阁整合包
description: Low-end PC friendly, integrating optimization, visual enhancements, and practical feature improvements
body:
[![Website](https://img.shields.io/badge/Website-mcpavilion.top-8e44ad?style=flat&logo=firefoxbrowser&logoColor=white)](https://mcpavilion.top) [![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Modrinth-Server_Page-00AF5C?style=flat&logo=modrinth&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/server/mcppl) ## PPL Modpack / 紫气阁整合包 * An optional modpack customized for the PurplePavilion server, but also suitable for singleplayer and all vanilla servers!
一个为紫气阁服务器定制的可选整合包，但也适用于单人模式和所有原版服务器！ * Designed for players who want a better Minecraft experience, especially on lower-end devices
它专为追求极致游戏体验且设备性能不佳的玩家打造 * It optimizes and enhances your Minecraft journey while preserving the vanilla experience
在保留原版体验的同时，全方位优化你的 Minecraft 之旅 ## Main Features / 主要特点 | Feature / 特点 | Description / 内容 | | --- | --- | | Tons of useful features
海量实用功能 | Includes the MASA suite, Jade, minimap mods, chat toolbox mods, and more
集成 MASA 全家桶、Jade、小地图、聊天工具箱等实用模组 | | Best vanilla experience
最佳原版体验 | The mods in this modpack do not add new items, keeping the gameplay as close to vanilla as possible
整合包中的模组不会为游戏添加新物品，尽可能保持原版玩法 | | Stability and compatibility
稳定与兼容性 | Every mod has been carefully selected and tested to avoid game-breaking bugs
每个模组的添加都经过深思熟虑与测试，绝无影响游玩的恶性 bug | | Visual and audio enhancements
全面美化 | Includes sound physics, improved audio, better particles, modernized UI, and other experience-enhancing mods
集成声音物理、音效改进、粒子改进、现代化 UI 等体验增强模组 | | Extreme optimization
极致优化 | Uses well-known optimization mods to reduce GPU and CPU load, greatly improving FPS and memory management efficiency
通过元素周期表等优化模组降低显卡和 CPU 压力，大幅提升帧数与内存管理效率 | | Fine-tuned settings
精细设置 | Game and mod settings have been optimized, with many useful but disabled-by-default features enabled
已优化游戏与模组设置，启用众多实用但默认禁用的功能 | | Resource pack enhancements
资源包增强 | Restores some essential OptiFine resource pack features, such as connected textures
还原部分必要的 OptiFine 资源包功能，例如连接纹理 | ## Preview / 预览图 ![PPL Modpack Preview 1 / 紫气阁整合包预览图 1](https://i.ibb.co/VYhqdmdS/image.png) ![PPL Modpack Preview 2 / 紫气阁整合包预览图 2](https://i.ibb.co/MDt3hSHv/image.png) ## Keybinds / 整合包按键说明 Note: All keybinds and settings can be adjusted in game
注：所有按键和配置都可以在游戏内自行调整 | Keybind / 按键 | Action / 功能 | | --- | --- | | `R` while inventory is open
`R` (打开背包时) | Sort inventory
一键整理 | | `CTRL + R` while inventory is open
`CTRL + R` (打开背包时) | View item recipes
查看物品配方 | | `U` while inventory is open
`U` (打开背包时) | View item usages
查看物品用途 | | `L` while inventory is open
`L` (打开背包时) | Favorite items
收藏物品 | | `CTRL + O` while inventory is open
`CTRL + O` (打开背包时) | Show / hide REI
显示 / 隐藏 REI | | `Z` | Zoom in on the minimap
放大小地图 | | `N` | Toggle the minimap
开 / 关小地图 | | `M` | Open the world map
打开大地图 | | `U` | Open the waypoint menu
打开路径点菜单 | | `O` | Open the shader selection screen
打开光影选择界面 | | `K` | Toggle shaders
开 / 关光影 | | `NUM 0` | Open Jade overlay settings
打开信息显示 (Jade) 设置 | | `NUM 1` | Toggle the information overlay
开 / 关信息显示 | | `X + C` | Open the MASA suite settings screen
打开 MASA 全家桶设置界面 | | `G` | Toggle high gamma
开 / 关高伽马值 | | `H` | Toggle night vision without server permissions
开 / 关夜视 (无需服务器权限) | | `CTRL + X` | Toggle freecam
开 / 关灵魂出窍 | | `CTRL + [` / `CTRL + ]` | Enable left-click / right-click auto clicking
开启左键 / 右键连点 | | `ALT + [` / `ALT + ]` | Enable periodic left-click / right-click clicking
开启左键 / 右键周期性点击 | | `Right ALT` | Open the schematic management screen
打开投影管理界面 | | `CTRL + J` | Toggle MiniHUD main rendering
MiniHUD 主渲染开关 | | `HOME` | Toggle fake sneak
开 / 关伪潜行 | | `END` | Enable automatic tool switching and some other features
开启自动切换工具和一些其他功能 | | `DEL` | Disable all particle, entity, and block entity rendering
禁用所有粒子、实体、方块实体渲染 | | `INSERT` | Toggle rendering invisible entities
开 / 关渲染隐身实体 | | `CTRL + PGUP` / `CTRL + PGDN` | Make nearby pets stand / sit
附近宠物起立 / 坐下 | | `CTRL + END` | Toggle the MiniHUD information overlays preset by the modpack. MiniHUD main rendering must be enabled
开 / 关整合包预设的 MiniHUD 信息显示 (需打开主渲染开关) | | `~` | Use vein mining. Only available in singleplayer and modded servers
使用连锁挖掘 (仅适用于单人和 Mod 服务器) |
